claim: Let \(A=\{a_0,a_1,a_2\}\subset\mathbb Z_N\) have three distinct elements. Put \(h=\gcd(N,a_1-a_0,a_2-a_0)\), \(n=N/h\), and \(A^\ast=\{(a-a_0)/h:a\in A\}\subset\mathbb Z_n\). Then \(A\) is spectral if and only if \(3\mid n\) and \(A^\ast\) is a complete set of residues modulo \(3\). In that case the nonzero Fourier-mask zero set is exactly \(Z(A)=\{d\in\mathbb Z_N:d\bmod n\in\{n/3,2n/3\}\}\); every three-element spectrum \(B\subset\mathbb Z_N\) is characterized by the condition that \(B\bmod n\) is a coset of \(\{0,n/3,2n/3\}\subset\mathbb Z_n\); and the number of distinct spectra is exactly \(Nh^2/3\).

correctness.rationale: After translation and gcd normalization, any mask zero is a sum of three unit complex numbers equal to zero, so the three phases form a rotated cube-root triple. Bézout then forces the frequency difference to be congruent to \(n/3\) or \(2n/3\), and this is possible exactly when the normalized support occupies all residues modulo \(3\). Pairwise differences then force every spectrum reduction to be exactly one order-three coset, and lift counting gives \(Nh^2/3\). The exact cyclotomic checker independently corroborates all components over the stated finite ranges.

value.rationale: Cardinality three is the first nontrivial spectral-set stratum beyond pairs. The result closes that stratum in every cyclic order with an explicit invariant, computes the complete mask-zero geometry, parametrizes every orthogonal character basis, and gives an exact basis count. These are structural data not supplied by a mere spectral-versus-tiling existence equivalence and can serve as a sharp base case for finite Fuglede and root-of-unity arguments.
